shop.name: The Forever Can
shop.deliveryNote: About $11.24 delivery on the live Etsy listing
shop.materials: Clear acrylic cylindrical shell, interchangeable nickel or gold metal insert, cutting template
shop.care: Wipe the acrylic. Swap the paper. No glue, no peel.
shop.lookbookNote: Bring leftover wallpaper from the wall you already hung — or start with this look. $59.95. Checkout is the live Etsy listing until custom SKUs exist.

howItWorks.title: Keep scraps
howItWorks.body: Hang the wallpaper as usual. Keep the leftover scraps from the roll — that remnant is the wrap.

howItWorks.title: Trace template
howItWorks.body: Lay the included cutting template on the leftover paper. Trace with a pen. One template, one wrap.

howItWorks.title: Cut & wrap
howItWorks.body: Cut the paper. Overlap the ends. Drop the wrap behind the clear acrylic shell. The metal insert holds it.

howItWorks.title: Swap anytime
howItWorks.body: The trash can disappears into the room. When you redecorate — or want seasonal paper, photos, or art — swap the wrap. The can lasts forever.
